explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 52 named tracks, releases and catalogue references across Bandcamp Daily's September 9, 2026 survey of August electronic releases, current adjacent footwork/garage/hardcore and global electronic windows, plus Graze's overlooked 2013 post-bass techno catalogue; attributed criticism and release metadata only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Bandcamp Daily's September 9, 2026 survey was screened across current electronic releases from Mexico, Thailand, Bulgaria, Chicago, South Africa, Colombia, Ukraine, the UK and the US. https://daily.bandcamp.com/best-electronic/the-best-new-electronic-music-on-bandcamp-august-2026

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: KAY BE's Bulgarian folk-hardcore, DJ Phil and HEAVEE's footwork/garage hybridity, chimp!'s slow-techno adjacency, South Beach Recycling's reduced house and Tee Illa / Nu Bantu Dialekt's low-tempo South African patience supplied materially different candidate routes from the same current survey.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Pitchfork's January 21, 2014 Edges review supplied exact routes through Graze's post-bass techno, including Spartan syncopation and swung groove that strains against its confines. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/18883-graze-edges/

FRESHNESS CHECK: repository searches found no durable exact decision, revisit, utility or unresolved entry for the nine requested identities. Recently selected Fis, Martyn, Tyler Friedman, Jlin, Vladislav Delay and Pearson Sound ecosystems were not recycled.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and prior unresolved leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.
Current items with no exact track title or no concrete rhythmic/structural route were screened but not requested.
Generic novelty, location, artist reputation and genre tags alone were insufficient.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
